counterfactual_missing_items: history of scrotal trauma or inflammation
cystic or anechoic appearance on ultrasonography
decisive_items: a solid, well-demarcated, hyperechoic, hypoperfused 1.3 × 1.1 cm mass at the tail of the right epididymis
a painless, round, hazelnut-sized mass localized to the tail of the right epididymis
response.rationale: R3 uniquely matches the solid, well-demarcated, hypoperfused epididymal tail mass with normal tumor markers, characteristic of adenomatoid tumor. R2 is a broad category lacking specificity, while R4 and R1 are contradicted by the solid imaging and lack of trauma history.

rejected.why: Epididymal cyst would appear anechoic and fluid-filled on ultrasound, not solid and hypoperfused.
Sperm granuloma typically follows trauma or inflammation, which is explicitly denied.
